cost.question: What does Veltrio cost?
cost.answer: A flat monthly subscription based on the size of your fleet. There is no commission and no charge per booking.

share.question: Does Veltrio take a share of my bookings?
share.answer: No. Renters pay the price you set, and all of it is yours. Our only income is your subscription.

paid.question: How do I get paid?
paid.answer: You connect your own Stripe account, and renters' online payments are paid out to it. Stripe charges its standard processing fee. You can also take cash at pick-up.

who.question: Who can list on Veltrio?
who.answer: Rental companies only. Veltrio is for businesses that rent out vehicles; private owners cannot list a personal car.

decline.question: Can I decline a booking request?
decline.answer: Yes. Every request waits for your confirmation, and the renter is not charged until you accept it.

trial.question: Is there a free trial?
trial.answer: Yes. Every plan starts with a 7-day free trial, so you can add your fleet and take bookings before you pay.
